status: Post hoc exploratory; protocol saved before this landmark fit, after broader cohort exploration
target: Observed W24 EASI <= 0.25 * observed W0 EASI; W0 EASI > 0
clinical_eligibility: Age>=12, unambiguous initial dose; same163 clinical participants
clinical_input_times: Demographics and initial treatment from W0, baseline_easi from W0; EASI, PP-NRS, IGA, BSA, adult DLQI from W12 only
primary_population: Observed W0 EASI>0 and W24 EASI, a W12 clinical record, and all three W12 markers observed and finite
sensitivity_population: Same outcome availability, at least one W12 panel marker; median imputation within training only
adolescent_DLQI: Mask W12 DLQI for age<18; predictor-only training imputation
predictor_availability: Only information available at or before W12; no W24 predictor or W0-to-W12 marker change input
secondary_evaluation: Patient probabilities averaged over repetitions before scoring, separately labelled
bootstrap_scope: Paired patient resampling retaining all repetitions, conditional on saved predictions; no refitting or historical selection uncertainty
reference: Matched clinical model; combined-minus-clinical AUROC/Brier intervals
limitations: Initial treatment does not represent current dose after change
Endpoint is W24 EASI75 relative to W0, not W12-to-W24 EASI improvement
no_adaptive_expansion: No new outcome, marker selection, panel size or model family based on landmark results
